scope: Additive TH18 Baby Dragon direct-parent and Tantrum support reconciliation. This delta preserves the frozen numeric catalogue and promotes only the existing shared-Core deterministic adapter to explicitly partial support.
game_version: Supercell confirms Baby Dragon level 12 as Town Hall 18 content. Neither the official release note nor the consulted secondary material identifies a current client build or a frame/tick transition contract.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
sources.version: Town Hall 18 update; client build not published
sources.limitations: The release note establishes Baby Dragon (+ Inferno Dragon) level 12 at Town Hall 18. It publishes neither a numeric L12 table nor Tantrum radius, eligible-allies set, modifier values, transition ordering, projectile geometry, collision or spell interactions.

sources.title: Baby Dragon
sources.limitations: Community-maintained current-looking material corroborates the frozen 4.5-tile allied-air isolation condition and doubled Tantrum damage, but is not an immutable client specification and gives no deterministic departure, re-entry, wind-up, in-flight, collision, splash or spell-order contract.

sources.title: Home Village Baby Dragon structured troop record
sources.limitations: The pinned public payload supplies frozen normal/enraged level data from which the frozen x1.5 attack-speed multiplier was derived. It predates later TH18 balance patches and does not define current client timing or a Tantrum state machine.

support.note: The shared Core evaluates the frozen allied-air isolation predicate from logical entity state every fixed tick, then applies the frozen x2 damage and derived x1.5 attack-speed multipliers. Headless, Viewer and RL call that same Core path. This marks an existing deterministic adaptation, not verified frame-accurate transition fidelity.

changed_values.previous_state: Frozen L1-L12 normal/enraged fields and the shared-Core Tantrum path existed, but the generated catalogue support label remained catalogued_only and focused coverage was absent.
changed_values.replacement: The unchanged parent data and existing shared-Core route are explicitly classified as core_supported_primary_secondary_partial, with focused snapshot, replay, determinism, Headless CLI and adapter coverage.
changed_values.justification: The source-backed radius and modifiers are already immutable GameData. The implementation recomputes the state from serialized logical positions, so it does not need unsnapshotted presentation state; unresolved transition details remain partial.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source supplies a version-identified client build or a tick/frame rule for ally departure, ally re-entry, target acquisition, wind-up preservation, an in-flight attack, cancellation, restoration or same-tick ordering of Tantrum.

No consulted source supplies Baby Dragon splash radius, projectile speed/launch/impact geometry, collision dimensions, target-loss ordering, spell interaction stacking, trap interaction, pathing geometry, or animation/silhouette fidelity for the applicable TH18 client.

The x1.5 attack-speed multiplier is a frozen derivation from the pinned normal/enraged table and documented x2 damage, rather than a primary-published modifier. The Core's ceiling quantization to 10-ms ticks is a deterministic adapter and is not presented as client-frame fidelity.
conclusion: Baby Dragon L1-L12, including the officially confirmed TH18 level 12, is available through the shared Core, Headless CLI, Viewer and RL route. Its source-backed isolation predicate and modifiers are deterministic and snapshot/replay-safe. Exact state-transition timing, projectile/splash geometry, interactions and visual fidelity remain explicitly partial.
